coordinates.rule: source cell(x,y) maps to target cells(2*x,2*y)..(2*x+1,2*y+1); crop only after full-view render

method.geometry: Same mesh, pose, lighting and PAL-correct orthographic frustum; only GPU raster160x100→320x200; both expand pixels2x2.
method.dither: Ordered4x4 Bayer remains at fixed raw screen-pixel pitch and phase; no bitmap/dither upscaling.
method.sourceSelection: Existing immutable-font matcher with per-occurrence object-mask admissibility, identical to accepted PAL renderer.
method.learned: For each normalized source shape and output quadrant, minimize SUM pixel Hamming to training2x reference bitmaps; lowest glyph-code ties.
method.modal: Most frequent observed direct-masked target quadruplet in training; lexicographic numeric tie.
method.duplicates: Identical font bitmaps normalize to lowest glyph code before histograms/training; aliases share LUT.
method.unseenFallback: Nearest font glyph per quadrant of literal2x repeated source glyph pixels; lowest code ties.
method.directMasked: Existing direct target renderer: independent per-cell Hamming fit, no white glyph bits allowed outside GPU object mask; NOT an unconditional Hamming lower bound.
method.directUnmasked: Independent per-target-cell minimum Hamming font fit without mask; true glyph context-loss lower bound.
method.literalPixels: Repeat every source glyph pixel2x2, no target-font fit.
method.literalFont: Nearest target font to each quadrant of literal repeated source glyph.
